EXPLANATION: The dominant Raman band at 1053 cm⁻¹ aligns well with strong C–F stretching in highly fluorinated systems (CF₂/CF₃ region 1024–1277 cm⁻¹; rule GFQ-058). Candidate 6 (a perfluorinated cyclobutane) is the only fully fluorinated organic among the options, consistent with a strong C–F band and sparse high-frequency features. The 1370 cm⁻¹ band can be attributed to higher-frequency CF-related modes/combination bands in perfluoro compounds, while the weak 3545 cm⁻¹ feature is plausibly due to trace OH contamination rather than an intrinsic X–H stretch in the molecule (no X–H in candidate 6). Other candidates would be expected to show characteristic bands (e.g., NO₂ ~1500–1600 cm⁻¹ or C=O ~1650–1750 cm⁻¹) not observed here.
